name: list_connections

summary: The connections of a service or a deployment.

summary: Create or update a deployment (inventory editor).

name: save_relation

summary: Create or update a service relation (inventory editor).

name: propose_document

summary: Propose a document for review (content editor runs started from a server, service or environment).

name: save_document
label: Save a document
summary: Save this run's draft of a document it may edit.

name: edit_document
label: Edit a document

label: Search memory
summary: Find what agents saved before, by words, meaning, metadata or agent.

summary: Read one memory entry in full.

name: save_memory

summary: Save a new fact or procedure under a unique name.

name: update_memory

summary: Replace an entry with a merged version (revision-checked).

name: load_skill

name: schedule_wakeup
label: Schedule a wake-up
summary: Continue this session later with a message to itself.

name: list_wakeups
label: List wake-ups
summary: This session's pending wake-ups.

name: cancel_wakeup
label: Cancel a wake-up
summary: Cancel a pending wake-up of this session.
